{{Quote|You ever carried out an assault on an urban objective before?''"<br />"''Yes. N'dian. Heard of it?''"<br />"''I meant one where you had to leave the place pretty well intact, sir.|Sev and Ordo|<ref name="RC">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
'''N'dian''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[N'dian system/Legends|N'dian system]], a part of the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="Trans-Hydian" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of several [[City/Legends|urban centers]]. A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] group was believed to be hiding in [[Unidentified city (N'dian)|one]] of the cities during that conflict. As a result, during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="RC" /> was sent to the planet to [[Battle of N'dian|assault]] the city. The ensuing battle was highly intense, with Ordo almost completely destroying the city single-handedly in order to achieve his mission objectives.<ref name="CSWE" />

During a [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|counterterrorism operation]] on<ref name="RC" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="RC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', which include the [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|counterterrorism operation]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Ordo discussed his mission to N'dian with the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]].<ref name="RC" />

==Behind the scenes==
N'dian was first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the N'dian [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet N'dian, within grid square R-6.<ref name="TEA" />
